units.rawText: My thanks, Professor. It just so happens that I have a present I'd like you to have, too.

units.rawText: Sakuya produces a delicate potted plant, handing it to me.

spans.text: Sakuya produces a delicate potted plant, handing it to me.

units.rawText: I am told that in China, people buy a variety of fresh flowers to make the year more auspicious at times like this, and they are referred to as Year's Eve flowers.
units.displayText: I am told that in China, people buy a variety of fresh flowers to make the year more auspicious at times like this, and they are referred to as Year's Eve flowers.

units.rawText: As such, I've prepared a pot of these for you, Professor. I pray that they bring you good fortune.

units.rawText: They're beautiful. Thank you, Sakuya. What exactly are these plants, though?

spans.text: They're beautiful. Thank you, Sakuya. What exactly are these plants, though?

units.rawText: This is lucky bamboo, and it signifies the blossoming of wealth. May your work be fruitful and your portents auspicious.
units.displayText: This is lucky bamboo, and it signifies the blossoming of wealth. May your work be fruitful and your portents auspicious.

spans.text: This is lucky bamboo, and it signifies the blossoming of wealth. May your work be fruitful and your portents auspicious.

units.rawText: These are peach blossoms, signifying long age and good health alongside good fortune. May you be possessed of bodily health and a peaceful future.

units.rawText: It is very much like you to convey your wishes through flowers, Sakuya. Thank you.
